text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I can offer no excuse for such a
miserable
showing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Though I do not believe I was neglectful
in my
preparations, I do feel as though I
could have
done more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the encouragement. I, too,
believe
that I successfully tapped into
my full potential.
choice_data_list: 走りに問題はなかった

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What I need to do now is hone my
abilities until
first place is within reach. I
do hope you'll assist
me in this endeavor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...! Of course. I have no intention of
simply giving
up now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall use the sting of this defeat to spur
me on
during training, starting tomorrow.
I shan't let you
down.
